RE: 401K vs 529 Question... 
Would the 401k be a traditional 401k or a Roth 401k? 
Typically, 529 plans are not tax deductible for federal purposes. However, the 
earnings will grow tax-deferred until the funds are distributed in the future. 
The funds in the 529 would need to be used for qualifying college expenses or 
could be subject to a 10% penalty upon withdrawal. 
Your resident state of III will allow up to a $10,000 annual deduction for joint 
filers. You can contribute more but would need to consider potential gift tax 
issues if giving more than S14,000 per year per recipient. 
If you contributed to a traditional 401k, you can put up to $18,000 for 2016, 
which you reduce your current year taxable income. 
Thanks

rail passes, train tickets, reservations and select city passes and tours issued through our

Important: 
• Changes and cancelations for paper tickets/rail passes/reservations/city passes must be 
received by Rail Europe no later than 3 business days before to the departure date from 
North America (that is provided at the time this booking is submitted). 
• Notification of changes or cancelations to e-tickets must be received no later than 3 
business days before to the original scheduled train departure (that is given at the time

Applying for an Exchange under the Rail Protection PIanTM 
• Rail passes/train tickets/reservations/city passes/tours may be exchanged for the same
